claims.quote: Serpenticobitis zonata is a small loach from the Xe Bangfai and Xe Bang Hiang drainages in Laos, and Chanthaburi province in south-eastern Thailand.
Serpenticobitis zonata is a small loach from the Xe Bangfai and Xe Bang Hiang drainages in Laos, and Chanthaburi province in south-eastern Thailand.
Known from the Xe Bangfai and Xe Bang Hiang river drainages in Laos, both of which are part of the middle Mekong basin, plus the south-eastern province of Chanthaburi, Thailand.
